g.text: 1 ~{STROBE} - Computer pulses low when data ready.

g.desc: 1 ~{STROBE} - Computer pulses low when data ready.

g.text: 10 ~{ACK} - Printer sets low to ack data read.

g.desc: 10 ~{ACK} - Printer sets low to ack data read.

g.text: 11 BUSY - Printer sets high while busy.

g.desc: 11 BUSY - Printer sets high while busy.

g.text: 12 PE - Printer sets high on paper end.

g.desc: 12 PE - Printer sets high on paper end.

g.text: 13 ONLINE - Printer sets high while on-line.

g.text: 14 ~{AUTOFD} or Supply GND - Computer sets low to request auto linefeed, or Power GND.

g.desc: 14 ~{AUTOFD} or Supply GND - Computer sets low to request auto linefeed, or Power GND.

g.text: 16 ~{RESET} - Computer sets low to reset printer.

g.text: 17 ~{SELIN} - Computer sets low to select printer.
